testsuite.name: dev.tramai.examples.springboot.ExampleApplicationTest

testcase.name: streaming service returns incremental summary chunks()
enrich endpoint simulates tool interaction with vendor lookup tool()
workflow events endpoint returns lifecycle events for async run()
workflow start endpoint returns accepted and result endpoint reaches completed()
workflow start rejects duplicate workflow id while first run is active()
workflow start reports failed status and persisted error when a step fails()
workflow events endpoint returns not found for unknown workflow()
native image proxy config stays in sync with the ai service contract()
triage endpoint returns typed structured response()
immediate cancellation before workflow execution persists CANCELLED()
summary endpoint returns raw text response()
workflow cancel stops active run and persists cancelled status()
health endpoint describes the example routes()
workflow list includes recent workflow runs()
context loads with tramai ai service bean()
workflow endpoint composes raw structured and tool-enabled steps with persisted checkpoint()
